name: @local/dsh-tool-center
description: Tool center for DeepSeek Harness — scenes, MCP servers, skills and prompts in one panel: workspace-bound scenes that only affect their own project, one panel listing every skill root, per-skill enable/disable without touching source files, same-name priority, detail preview, create/edit/delete with trash, single-skill and ZIP import/export. Session-scope layering remains a reserved interface.
